tips.text: Run Void Flood, Void Cascade or Void Armageddon as a relic fissure, solo or with a premade squad, and stay in: Eximus spawn more the longer you stay and the same runs drop the part blueprints.
Stay for Rotation C; leaving after round 3 is the most common public-squad failure.
Take any blueprint that drops, then buy the rest with Entropic Kuva instead of waiting on the drop.
Stay on normal mode; Steel Path gives no extra Entropic Kuva per kill.
Expect about 90 minutes to a few hours of fissure runs to buy the whole frame with Entropic Kuva.
Early posts called this farm awful, but later ones call it fine because every rotation pays and the Kuva shop works as a pity buy.
